preReview.title: Wicky: Vancouver an example for Sporting KC to follow
preReview.description: Sporting Kansas City were beaten by the Vancouver Whitecaps last time out, and Raphael Wicky said his team should aim to play like them.

preReview.title: Wicky: Vancouver es el ejemplo que debe seguir Sporting KC
preReview.description: Sporting Kansas City cayó ante Vancouver Whitecaps y Raphael Wicky señaló que su equipo debe tomar como referencia su estilo de juego.

preReview.title: Wicky: Vancouver è il modello da seguire per lo Sporting KC
preReview.description: Dopo la sconfitta dello Sporting Kansas City, Raphael Wicky indica i Vancouver Whitecaps come modello per la sua squadra.

preReview.description: Após derrota para o Vancouver Whitecaps, Raphael Wicky diz que o Sporting Kansas City deve seguir o exemplo do rival.

preReview.description: Sporting Kansas City unterlag zuletzt den Vancouver Whitecaps. Raphael Wicky sieht den Gegner als spielerisches Vorbild für seine Mannschaft.
